name: B10-0282/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Georgian journalist Mzia Amaglobeli, who was arrested and faces up to seven years in prison. It condemns what it describes as a campaign by Georgia's ruling party against independent journalists and protesters. It also asks the European Union and its member states to impose sanctions on those responsible, including Bidzina Ivanishvili, and to support Georgia's independent media after a new law took effect on 1 June.

- The report asks for Amaglobeli's release and sanctions on Georgian officials; it does not itself change any law.
- It affects Georgia's government, police, independent media and protesters.
- Next, the Parliament sends its request to EU leaders and Georgian authorities, who decide whether to act.
